title: Certified-QMC v1.0: Exact Lattice-Rule Evaluation and Replayable Certificates
description: An exact evaluation engine, independent verifier, and curated conformance oracle for rank-1 lattice-rule figures of merit. The release certifies rational squared shift-averaged worst-case errors in the product-weight Bernoulli-B2 convention using an independently verified prime schedule, hash-chained residue chunks, bounded balanced-CRT reconstruction, two universal overflow checks, and one-command selected-entry replay. Supplementary exhaustive reference merits cover the UNSW fixed 29102 and extensible 39102 families. Upstream generating vectors are keyed by publisher citation and SHA-256 and are not redistributed.
notes: Project-authored tables and documentation are CC-BY-4.0. Source code is Apache-2.0 as stated in the included LICENSE. Third-party generating vectors are not embedded.
